headline: Super Micro (SMCI) Faces ITC Patent Investigation Over Netlist Memory Tech
summary: The U.S. International Trade Commission has opened an investigation into alleged infringement of Netlist memory patents by Super Micro Computer (NasdaqGS:SMCI) and other companies. The case centers on certain memory technologies that may be used in servers and data center hardware. The ITC process can lead to potential import bans or other trade remedies that affect hardware shipments into the U.S. This investigation adds a new legal and regulatory issue for SMCI investors to monitor through...
